verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a hosted payment facilitator, but the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for payment or settlement events. The facilitator "reports the result to your resource server" only as part of the synchronous verify/settle request flow, which is an adjacent behavior and not a webhook subscription. Bazaar discovery is pull-based search, not event delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
